Metadata.title: Simplist
Metadata.description: Manage your tasks and lists with ease using Simplist.

welcome.title: Welcome to Simplist 👋
welcome.content: Here's a one-minute look at where everything is. You can skip the tour at any time and see it again from Help & Support.

navigation.title: Getting around
navigation.content: Home, the Calendar with every due date, and Search, which finds lists, sections and tasks (also with Ctrl + K).

lists.title: Your lists
lists.content: Your lists live here. The + creates a new one: inside you add sections and tasks, with a date, repeat and reminder.

shared.title: Shared with you
shared.content: Lists other people share with you show up here. The role they give you decides whether you can edit them.

profile.title: Your account
profile.content: Your profile opens the settings: language, appearance, notifications and invites for new people.

help.title: Help
help.content: Documentation, keyboard shortcuts and this tour, whenever you want to see it again.

menu.title: The menu
menu.content: Tap here to open the menu: your lists, the ones shared with you, the calendar, search and settings.

actions.title: Quick actions
actions.content: Tap a task to open its details. To edit or delete, use the … button or a long press. To move it, drag the ⋮⋮ handle.

install.title: Install the app
install.content: Add Simplist to your Home Screen to open it like an app and get reminders. On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen.

done.title: You're all set!
done.content: Create your first list and add a few tasks. Want reminders? Turn on notifications on this device.
